title: Play it in behind the full-back
brief: The ball comes back to you near the touchline. Their full-back has stepped in front of your winger.
briefKid: The ball is coming to you. Look where your winger can run.
question: Where does your pass go?

takeaway.standard: When a defender steps in front of your winger, pass into the space behind the defender, so your winger runs onto it.
takeaway.kid: Pass into the space behind the defender, so your winger runs onto it.

notes: A full-back's ball into space (PA8), which the pass generator never makes for full-backs (PASS_YIELD). Their full-back stands 3 m in front of our winger, so the pass to the winger's feet is blocked (PA4), and the space behind is ours: the winger is already facing forward and wins the race. Their winger presses our near centre-back, so the short pass back is cut out too.
